text:
Noah: Quick sync  uploaded new roles panel mock; priority: reduce scan time for admins on Org Settings.

Maya: Nice. Two issues: the legend gets heavy with many roles; SSO toggle help text pushes content down.

Oliver: Idea: compress descriptions into compact pills and reveal details on demand.

Hana: Accessibility: no hover-only reveals. Expanders must be keyboard operable (aria-expanded), have focus styles, and meet contrast 4.5.

Maya: Pattern: pill shows name+badge, chevron button expands inline details. Chevron should be a <button aria-controls=>.

Sam: Engineering: lazy-render details for large orgs; animate height (160ms) to reduce layout shift; focus after animationend.

Oliver: I'll mock two options: inline expanders and an alt side-panel (less shift).

Noah: SSO copy: prefer short. Draft: "Enforce SSO for everyone — recommended." Add tertiary link "Why this matters" -> opens modal.

Hana: Modal must trap focus, title tabindex=-1 and receive programmatic focus, Esc to close. Include audit implications.

Oliver: Users can't find SSO events. Suggest "View SSO events" quick-filter next to the toggle linking to /orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce.

Sam: Backend already tags events with event_type: sso.enforce. Frontend will URL-encode filter and deep-link. Will add aria-live for rollout messages.

Maya: When SSO toggled ON show confirmation panel focused. Primary CTA should be "Start SSO rollout". Ensure tab order: title -> primary -> secondary -> rest.

Hana: Tooltips need accessible names; don't rely on visual-only hints.

Noah: Action items: Oliver update mocks; Hana write a11y checklist; Sam prototype deep-link & focus timing; Maya schedule 5-person usability test.

design-bot: New mock: https://figma.redwood.com/file/abc123/roles-compact - comments enabled.

Maya: I'll run the test next week, keep modal copy to one-liners.

Oliver: Will upload updated frames and keyboard states.

Sam: Prototyping focus behavior today and will post a short recording.

Noah: Closing: ensure deep-link uses URL-encoded filter, confirmation panel supports Esc, and both toolbar + inline "View SSO events" land to same filtered audit view.
